visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A cartoon pig-like character with glasses, a red cap, and a red cape featuring a gold '$' buckle stands behind a wooden table. The background is a dark, rocky cave with a glowing sword embedded in a stone. (2) A minimalist black-and-white animation of a dome with steps appears, transitioning into the 'Meridian Project' logo. (3) A sequence of colorful, stylized silhouettes of six female anime-style characters appears against a vibrant, striped background. (4) The screen displays the full designs of the six VTubers (Mizuki, Seki, Hibiki, Rei, Yuzumi, Kirali) in a dynamic lineup, followed by individual close-ups showing their detailed outfits and facial expressions. (5) The VTubers are seen performing on a high-tech virtual stage with neon lights, geometric patterns, and digital displays. (6) The pig character reappears, performing a thumbs-up gesture and later holding a large stack of blue banknotes towards the camera. (7) Screen recordings of a ticketing website (KKTIX) are shown, detailing the event 'MeridiaNight' with a group photo of the performers. (8) The video concludes with the pig character back in the cave, waving and smiling at the viewer.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male narrator saying 'Hello hello, microphone test,' accompanied by an upbeat, bouncy electronic background music (BGM) featuring a steady 4/4 drum beat and bright synth pads. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers as the narrator asks if the audience knows about the 'Meridian Project.' The music maintains a constant high tempo, complementing the fast speech rate. (3) As the virtual performers are introduced, digital UI 'blip' and 'ding' sound effects are synchronized with their names appearing. The narrator's tone is consistently enthusiastic and promotional. (4) A distinct 'cha-ching' cash register sound effect plays when the narrator mentions the affordable ticket price of TWD $500, followed by a playful paper rustling sound as he mentions 'spending one less Gacha session.' (5) The audio concludes with a final energetic call to action and a smooth fade-out of the BGM as the narrator invites viewers to comment on their favorite performer.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction -> Product/Event Detail -> Cast Reveal -> Pricing/CTA -> Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional advertisement for the 'MeridiaNight' 3D virtual concert organized by the Meridian Project. It aims to inform fans about the event date, the lineup of VTubers, ticket prices, and how to purchase them, using an energetic cartoon host to maintain viewer engagement.
